name: Magma Boulder
primary:
A huge magma boulder that leaves a hot patch and shards.
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and explodes in a 3-block radius on hit. 3 shards scatter around with the same effects on creatures they touch. Effects:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire + 2.5 ❤ earth (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 6 blocks within 1 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Leaves a 2-block zone for 5 s that repeats these effects every second
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 9 s
• Slowness II for 7 s
